predecessors.name: Republic of Siena
predecessors.text: the Presidi: Orbetello, Talamone, Ansedonia, Porto Ercole and Porto Santo Stefano on the Tuscan coast, with Porto Longone on Elba

successors.name: Kingdom of Etruria
successors.text: the Presidi: Orbetello, Talamone, Ansedonia, Porto Ercole and Porto Santo Stefano on the Tuscan coast, with Porto Longone on Elba

ledger.x: 29 May 1557: Philip II fixes the Presidi.

1708: the Austrian Habsburgs hold the Presidi through their viceroy in Naples ('1708-1733: Austrian Habsburgs, administered by their viceroy in Naples'); before it was the Spanish Crown, 'administered by the Spanish Habsburg viceroy of Naples' from 1557.
May 1735: the Presidi pass to Don Carlos.
19 September 1801: the Presidi pass to Etruria.
1801: the State of the Presidi ends; 'its fate follows that of the rest of Tuscany'.

certainty.note: A few fortified towns with a hinterland; no page gives lines.
